name: @withmarfa/integration-google-drive
description: Inbound-only Google Drive connector (Drive v3 API). Schedule trigger seeds + incrementally syncs via files.list + changes.list with a persisted pageToken cursor; webhook trigger receives changes.watch push notifications and triggers a re-sync. Reuses the Google OAuth provider credential established for the google.* family via credential_ref. Supports `download_mode: metadata` (default) and `download_mode: all-files` (non-Google-native files within the per-file ceiling ingested as core.file with blob_ref). Outbound writes deferred.
